notes.title: Build .94 Uploaded
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33916308/e6b8daaa3512320db67750b9897f833ed63c5499.png[/img]

Greetings Commanders.  Fairly small list of changes uploaded today.

[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug where picking up escape and life pods was not awarding data.
[*]  Fixed a bug that made the derelict cruiser missions too easy.
[*]  Fixed several spelling mistakes in the dialogue.
[*]  Removed escape and life pods from spawning in several levels they did not belong in.
[*]  Fixed a mouse scrolling bug.
[*]  Slightly reduced the accuracy of Shredder Cannons.
[*]  Fixed a cutscene issue.
[\list]

And that is all for now.  Thank you for testing the game.

notes.title: Build .93 Uploaded
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33916308/f6f71185cc7a7dd841d7319462e7e93e3c7e6711.png[/img]

Greetings Commanders.  Thank you so much to everyone that has tried out the game and provided us feedback.  This is really helpful and we really appreciate it.  Together we will make this the best game it can be.

Today's patch address some of the themes we have been seeing:

[list][*] Fixed a bug where the final story mission couldn't be completed.
[*]  Fixed a bug on the Heartless mission where you could fly into the asteroid base.
[*]  Slowed down the dialogue so it was easier to read.
[*]  Fixed a loading bug related to certain equipment.
[/list]

And that is all for now.  Thank you for playing our games.

notes.title: Build .91 Uploaded
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33916308/e6b8daaa3512320db67750b9897f833ed63c5499.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to Steel Shadows[/b]

OK, the initial build is up.  Welcome to Steel Shadows and the Orion sector.  This will let you play through the first 5 story missions.

Please use the forums or any of our company email addresses to send us feedback (contact@fwsgame.com).  In addition to general feedback, we are looking for total play times to get through the first five missions, as well as feedback on each of the three difficulty levels.  Please also include which save style you chose.

There are several known issues with the current build, so no need to send us feedback on the following:

[list]
[*] Loading is not working for anything but the most recent save.  We are working on it.
[*]  The 'Derelict Cruiser' Bounty mission is not loading.  We have substituted another mission in its place for the time being.
[*]  Not all of the ships are currently available for purchase.
[*]  The 'Heartless' Mercenary mission does not have any dialogue.  This will be added soon(tm).
[*]  Not all of the events are loading for some players.
[*]  The 'Rickshaw' deployment cost is wrong.
[/list]

Enjoy.
